description.en: 15 Agent Skills and three mutually exclusive MCP rows (compare-mcp, decision-mcp, marketplace-mcp) for 12 Russian and Chinese marketplaces and classifieds: cross-marketplace price comparison and per-source search, product cards, seller details and reviews across Wildberries, Ozon, Yandex Market, Detsky Mir, Avito, AliExpress, Taobao, Megamarket, Lamoda, DNS, Citilink, and Cian real estate. Read-only, no API keys required; skills load on install while MCP rows stay disabled until RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR is set.
description.zh: 面向 12 家俄罗斯与中国电商及分类信息平台的 15 个 Agent 技能与三行互斥 MCP 配置（compare-mcp、decision-mcp、marketplace-mcp）：支持跨平台比价，以及 Wildberries、Ozon、Yandex Market、Detsky Mir、Avito、AliExpress（速卖通）、Taobao（淘宝）、Megamarket、Lamoda、DNS、Citilink 的商品搜索、详情卡、卖家信息与评论，外加 Cian 房产搜索。只读且无需 API Key；安装后 15 个技能立即可用，MCP 行默认关闭，设置 RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR 后按需启用。
